## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the user-visible problem and what this change does.

## Validation

List actual commands and outcomes, plus any checks not run. For UI changes, include synthetic-data screenshots and note keyboard, theme, and narrow-layout checks.

## Content and data

- [ ] New exercise content is original or has documented redistribution permission and attribution.
- [ ] Exercise changes include a passing reference, edge cases, and representative incorrect solutions that fail.
- [ ] Saved-project compatibility, immutable submitted evidence, and MCP contracts are preserved or migration effects are explained.
- [ ] No credentials, personal databases/backups, local assistant configuration, or generated test/build artifacts are included.

Mark items that do not apply and explain material limitations or follow-up work.
